query:
select m.id, m.session_id, m.seq, m.speaker, m.body, m.sent_at, m.captured_at
               from messages m
               where m.session_id = $1
                 and ($2::uuid is null
                      or m.seq > (select seq from messages where id = $2 and session_id = $1))
                 and ($4::uuid is null
                      or group_visible((select p.group_id from sessions s
                                        join projects p on p.id = s.project_id
                                        where s.id = m.session_id), $4))
               order by m.seq
               limit $3
